answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work — a new identity earns almost nothing until 11 epochs of honest answers are on record. Cloning 940 keys multiplies the waiting, not the payout, and any junk verdict resets the clock. The rate is earned, not bought, so money cannot shortcut the wait. The horizon test is the live device, the comet test is the locked stake, and the onyx test is the graded history no template can fake. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
